verdict.line: You lose if you stand and trade into his level 6 All Out engage; you win if you punish him with your E stun chain before he hits 6.

brief.thesis: K'Sante has no way to force a fight before level 6 outside a short-range Q poke, while Irelia's E stun plus Q reset lets her dictate every trade in that window. At 6, R (All Out) flips the fight — he knocks you through terrain and transforms, and his W stops stunning but hits harder, so the matchup becomes about surviving his opener rather than trading into the transformed kit.

theirWindow.what: He knocks you back through terrain then dashes in transformed — W (Path Maker) no longer stuns but deals more damage, and E (Footwork) is faster. Don't stand and trade the transform; disengage toward turret or bait it out before re-engaging.

yourWindow.when: His E (Footwork) and W both on cooldown
yourWindow.what: Land E (Flawless Duet) for the stun and Mark, Q (Bladesurge) onto the marked target to refresh its cooldown, then chain into W (Defiant Dance) — he has no dash or shield left to escape.

start.why: Sustain and early trade damage against his short-cooldown Q poke.

boots.why: He's a melee physical duelist — armor and auto-attack reduction blunt his Q chip and All Out autos.

core.why: Spellblade proc plus attack speed feeds your passive stacking for extended trades.
Shreds his armor stacking so your on-hit damage keeps scaling as he builds tank.

runes.keystoneWhy: Extended trades favor you once stacked, and it offsets his tank itemization in prolonged skirmishes.

summoners.why: Ignite lets you close out kills during your levels 3-5 dominance window before his R (All Out) comes online.

playing.title: Bait his Q stacks
playing.detail: At 2 stacks his Q fires a shockwave that pulls you in. Don't stand in his short-line Q range when he's one hit from the pull.

playing.title: All-in before level 6
playing.detail: Use E (Flawless Duet) to stun and mark, then Q (Bladesurge) for the reset into W (Defiant Dance). He has no answer to this chain pre-6.

playing.title: Track his E cooldown
playing.detail: Footwork is his only dash/shield, on an 8-10s cooldown depending on rank. All-in when it's down.

playing.title: Respect walls after level 6
playing.detail: R (All Out) knocks you through terrain in his direction. Don't fight near walls once he's 6.

playing.title: Charge W through his Q poke
playing.detail: W (Defiant Dance) reduces physical damage taken while charging, so hold the charge through his Q to negate chip damage.

playing.title: Confirm Q resets on marked targets
playing.detail: Bladesurge only refreshes its cooldown if the target is Marked or dies — always land your mark first for the full reset chain.
